question: How many open opportunities are there?

ref.soql: SELECT COUNT() FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false

question: What is the total amount of open pipeline?

ref.soql: SELECT SUM(Amount) v FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false

question: Show open pipeline by stage, with the total amount for each stage.

ref.soql: SELECT StageName k, StageName n, SUM(Amount) v FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false GROUP BY StageName

question: Which 5 open opportunities have the largest amounts?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false ORDER BY Amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

question: Which open opportunities close this month?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND CloseDate = THIS_MONTH

question: How many contacts work at accounts in the Communications industry?

ref.soql: SELECT COUNT() FROM Contact WHERE Account.Industry = 'Communications'

question: Which open cases belong to accounts in the Communications industry?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM Case WHERE IsClosed = false AND Account.Industry = 'Communications'

question: How many open opportunities are at prospect accounts?

ref.soql: SELECT COUNT() FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND Account.Type = 'Prospect'

question: Which opportunity contact roles are on opportunities at accounts in the Communications industry?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM OpportunityContactRole WHERE Opportunity.Account.Industry = 'Communications'

question: How many opportunity contact roles are for contacts at Customer - Direct accounts?

ref.soql: SELECT COUNT() FROM OpportunityContactRole WHERE Contact.Account.Type = 'Customer - Direct'

question: Which accounts have no opportunities at all?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id NOT IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Opportunity)

question: Which opportunities have no contact roles?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM Opportunity WHERE Id NOT IN (SELECT OpportunityId FROM OpportunityContactRole)

question: How many contacts have a role on at least one opportunity?

ref.soql: SELECT COUNT() FROM Contact WHERE Id IN (SELECT ContactId FROM OpportunityContactRole)

question: For each account with open cases, how many open cases does it have?

ref.soql: SELECT AccountId k, Account.Name n, COUNT(Id) v FROM Case WHERE IsClosed = false GROUP BY AccountId, Account.Name

question: Which accounts have more than 3 open opportunities?

soql: SELECT AccountId FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false GROUP BY AccountId HAVING COUNT(Id) > 3
SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id IN :prev

question: How many cases are escalated or high priority?

ref.soql: SELECT COUNT() FROM Case WHERE Status = 'Escalated' OR Priority = 'High'

question: Which open opportunities are in Prospecting or have an amount over 250,000?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (StageName = 'Prospecting' OR Amount > 250000)

question: How many accounts are in the Energy or Technology industries?

ref.soql: SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Industry = 'Energy' OR Industry = 'Technology'

question: Which tasks are either not started or due in the next 7 days?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM Task WHERE Status = 'Not Started' OR ActivityDate = NEXT_N_DAYS:7

question: How many open opportunities either close this quarter with an amount over 200,000, or are in Negotiation/Review?

ref.soql: SELECT COUNT() FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND ((CloseDate = THIS_QUARTER AND Amount > 200000) OR StageName = 'Negotiation/Review')

question: Which accounts have an open case?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Case WHERE IsClosed = false)

question: Which accounts have both an open case and an open opportunity over 200,000?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Case WHERE IsClosed = false) AND Id IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND Amount > 200000)

question: Which contacts work at accounts that have an open case?

ref.soql: SELECT Id FROM Contact WHERE AccountId IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Case WHERE IsClosed = false)

question: Which accounts have an open case and no completed task in the last 30 days?

soql: SELECT AccountId FROM Task WHERE Status = 'Completed' AND ActivityDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30 AND AccountId != null
SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Case WHERE IsClosed = false) AND Id NOT IN :prev

question: Which accounts mention renewal in their description?

ref.soql: SELECT Id, Description FROM Account

question: Which events have a description that mentions pricing?

ref.soql: SELECT Id, Description FROM Event

question: Of the 5 largest open opportunities, which close before the end of this year?

soql: SELECT Id FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false ORDER BY Amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
SELECT Id FROM Opportunity WHERE Id IN :prev AND CloseDate <= 2026-12-31

question: What is the total open pipeline at accounts that have an open case?

ref.soql: SELECT SUM(Amount) v FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND AccountId IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Case WHERE IsClosed = false)

question: How many active products are there?

ref.soql: SELECT COUNT() FROM Product2 WHERE IsActive = true
